subject: Novacorp cloud marketplace private-offer: approval roadmap + eval checkpoints
messages:
From: Alicia Mills <alicia.mills@novacorp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: 2028-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novacorp marketplace private-offer — procurement steps & MAP request

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. To get our internal approval moving we need a single, consolidated Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps the private-offer flow for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace purchases, including:

- Evaluation milestones (PoC window, acceptance criteria, test workloads)
- Procurement checkpoints (finance sign-off, legal redlines, PO submission)
- Billing path (marketplace private-offer billing vs direct billing, billing entity options)
- Expected dates to get to a signed PO and activation

Can you share a MAP we can drop into our procurement review this week? Also include any required artifacts for our security/compliance and the preferred billing entity names for a marketplace private-offer.

We'd like to aim for a 4-week cadence from PoC start to activation if possible — is that realistic?

Appreciate it,

Alicia Mills
Head of Procurement — Novacorp
Alicia.Mills@novacorp.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-10-25T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novacorp marketplace private-offer — procurement steps & MAP request

Hi Alicia,

Thanks — helpful summary. I've attached a draft MAP (Novacorp_MAP_draft.xlsx) and an evaluation checklist (MAP_eval_checklist.md) that map the private-offer path across AWS/GCP/Azure and the billing options we typically see. High-level answers to your questions below.

Is a 4-week cadence workable? Yes — provided we have:
- SOW/PoC acceptance criteria agreed within 3 business days of PoC kickoff
- Your finance team confirms billing entity on day 2 of procurement review
- Legal receives redlines no later than day 7 so we can iterate quickly

Quick highlights from the attached MAP:
- Week 0: Contract setup & marketplace private-offer creation (we prepare offer & AWS/GCP/Azure listing)
- Week 1: PoC kickoff (2-week PoC recommended; customer supplies test dataset + SLOs)
- Week 3: Evaluation sign-off; procurement issues PO or signs purchase terms
- Week 4: Activation and billing enablement (marketplace product goes live to your account)

Billing entity: for marketplace private-offers we can route billing either to your AWS marketplace account (marketplace billing) or to Novacorp via direct invoice (if you prefer direct billing we'll need the billing entity name and tax details). The MAP lists required fields.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement contact and billing entity (reply to this thread).
2) If you want, we can lock a PoC start date as early as Nov 1 — we have capacity then.

Sharing the attachments now.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Manager 
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Novacorp_MAP_draft.xlsx; MAP_eval_checklist.md

Subject: Re: Novacorp marketplace private-offer — procurement steps & MAP request

Alicia / Grace — adding technical and rollout notes.

We recommend the following for a low-risk evaluation and fast activation:

- PoC scope (recommended): 2 production-like endpoints, representative 10k tokens/day workload, one-week peak traffic spike test.
- Canary rollout: after acceptance, enable the private-offer for a single Novacorp AWS account (billing -> marketplace) for 72 hours before full activation.
- KV/prefix caching: we'll share a config that reduces per-token cost during evaluation; it also historically helps meet latency SLOs.

Notes on billing paths:
- Marketplace private-offer (AWS/GCP/Azure): quickest for procurement teams that want consolidated cloud billing. Marketplace billing is gated by the cloud provider's cadence (activation may take 24-72 hours after PO ingestion).
- Direct invoicing: requires finance onboarding; final activation usually happens same day after PO is received and verified by our finance team.

I've added a short tech appendix in the MAP (tab: TechAppendix) and included a HubSpot link to the deal for your procurement team: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/novacorp (see timeline & documents).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
